WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (snapshot->>'workspace_id',snapshot->>'kind',snapshot->>'id') snapshot,id,baseline
 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS b(id bigint,snapshot jsonb,baseline boolean)
 WHERE snapshot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY snapshot->>$2,snapshot->>$3,snapshot->>$4,baseline,id DESC
), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.*,f.snapshot AS previous FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN metric_snapshot_facts f
 ON f.workspace_id=(c.snapshot->>$5)::uuid AND f.source_kind=c.snapshot->>$6 AND f.source_id=(c.snapshot->>$7)::uuid
 WHERE f.source_id IS NULL OR (NOT c.baseline AND (f.baseline OR c.id>f.sequence))
), changes AS (
 SELECT snapshot,$8 AS sign FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT previous,$9 FROM eligible WHERE previous IS NOT NULL
), expanded AS (
 SELECT (snapshot->>$10)::uuid AS workspace_id,(snapshot->>$11)::uuid AS journey_id,(snapshot->>$12)::date AS cohort_day,(snapshot->>$13)::uuid AS version_id,v->>$14 AS dimension,v->>$15 AS dimension_key,v->>$16 AS metric,(v->>$17)::double precision*sign AS value
 FROM changes CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->$18) v
), totals AS (
 INSERT INTO journey_cohort_metrics SELECT workspace_id,journey_id,cohort_day,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric,sum(value) FROM expanded GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 HAVING sum(value)<>$19
 ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,cohort_day,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=journey_cohort_metrics.value+EXCLUDED.value RETURNING $20
), members AS (
 INSERT INTO journey_cohort_members SELECT DISTINCT (snapshot->>$21)::uuid,(snapshot->>$22)::uuid,(snapshot->>$23)::date,(snapshot->>$24)::uuid,snapshot->>$25 FROM eligible WHERE snapshot->>$26=$27 AND snapshot->>$28 IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING $29
)
INSERT INTO metric_snapshot_facts(workspace_id,source_kind,source_id,sequence,baseline,snapshot)
SELECT (snapshot->>$30)::uuid,snapshot->>$31,(snapshot->>$32)::uuid,id,baseline,snapshot FROM eligible
ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,so

WITH due AS (
 SELECT j.id FROM scheduled_jobs j
 WHERE j.state=$3 AND j.due_at<=$1
 AND (SELECT e.state IN ($4,$5) AND f.status IN ($6,$7)
      FROM journey_executions e JOIN journeys f ON f.id=e.journey_id WHERE e.id=j.execution_id)
 ORDER BY j.due_at,j.id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
 ), claimed AS (UPDATE scheduled_jobs j SET state=$8,claim_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_until=$1+interval $9,attempts=j.attempts+$10 FROM due WHERE j.id=due.id RETURNING j.*)
 SELECT c.id::text,c.workspace_id::text,c.execution_id::text,e.customer_id,e.journey_id::text,c.node_id,c.kind,c.claim_token::text,c.attempts,e.trace_parent,c.due_at FROM claimed c JOIN journey_executions e ON e.id=c.execution_id

WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT * FROM journey_cohort_metrics WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND journey_id=$2 AND cohort_day>=$3::date AND cohort_day<$4::date AND ($5=$10 OR version_id=NULLIF($5,$11)::uuid) AND ($5<>$12 OR dimension IN ($13,$14,$15,$16))
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   $17,jsonb_build_object($18,$6::int,$19,$7::int,$20,CASE WHEN $7::int=$21 THEN $22 ELSE $3::timestamptz END,$23,$4::timestamptz,$24,$25,$26,$27),
   $28,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m)) FROM (SELECT dimension,dimension_key AS key,metric,sum(value) AS value FROM scoped GROUP BY 1,2,3)m),$29::jsonb),
   $30,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.day) FROM (SELECT cohort_day AS day,metric,sum(value) AS value FROM scoped WHERE dimension=$31 AND metric IN ($32,$33) GROUP BY 1,2)d),$34::jsonb),
   $35,CASE WHEN $9::boolean THEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM journey_cohort_members WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND journey_id=$2 AND cohort_day>=$3::date AND cohort_day<$4::date AND ($5=$36 OR version_id=NULLIF($5,$37)::uuid)) ELSE $38 END,
   $39,NOT EXISTS(SELECT $40 FROM metric_snapshot_backfill WHERE NOT complete),
   $41,(SELECT last_success FROM metric_projection_health WHERE id),
   $42,(SELECT processed_at FROM metric_watermarks WHERE workspace_id=$1),
   $43,(SELECT source_at FROM metric_watermarks WHERE workspace_id=$1),
   $44,(SELECT created_at FROM metric_queue ORDER BY id LIMIT $45),
   $46,$8::text,
   $47,(SELECT count(DISTINCT e.id) FROM scheduled_jobs q JOIN journey_executions e ON e.workspace_id=q.workspace_id AND e.id=q.execution_id WHERE q.workspace_id=$1 AND q.state=$48 AND q.due_at<statement_timestamp()-interval $49 AND e.journey_id=$2 AND e.state=$50 AND e.started_at>=$3 AND e.started_at<$4 AND ($5=$51 OR e.version_id=NULLIF($5,$52)::uuid) AND $8::text IN ($53,$54))
  )

metric,(d->>$8)::double precision AS value FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS b(workspace_id uuid,journey_id uuid,version_id uuid,cohort_at timestamptz,customer_id text,deltas jsonb,created_at SETS((workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric),(workspace_id,journey_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric),(workspace_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric)) HAVING sum(value)<>$12 AND (dimension<>$13 OR grouping(version_id)=$14) ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=metric_totals.value+excluded.value RETURNING $15), journeys AS (INSERT INTO metric_totals SELECT workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric,sum(value) FROM expanded WHERE dimension=$16 GROUP BY workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric HAVING sum(value)<>$17 ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=metric_totals.value+excluded.value RETURNING $18) INSERT INTO metric_hourly SELECT workspace_id,COALESCE(journey_id,$19),COALESCE(version_id,$20),bucket,dimension,dimension_key,metric,sum(value)    SELECT e.customer_id,e.state,c.email,c.phone,c.consents,COALESCE(s.frequency_limit,$6) AS frequency_limit,COALESCE(s.frequency_window_seconds,$7) AS frequency_window_seconds
   FROM journey_executions e JOIN customers c ON c.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND c.customer_id=e.customer_id

   WHERE e.id=o.execution_id AND (SELECT j.status IN ($8,$9) FROM journeys j WHERE j.id=e.journey_id)

database_wait_sampling.meaning: Sampled active-backend occupancy, not exact wait duration. CPU_or_not_waiting does not establish CPU saturation. Query IDs correlate with statement statistics; inactive transactions and diagnostic connection are excluded.

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

method: Real loopback HTTP ingestion and actual PostgreSQL runtime/delivery/projector, warm local Docker database. Fixture creates 1,000 inactive draft journeys and synthetic customers. Stage A reaches the requested number of simultaneously WAITING durable executions (MVP threshold: 10,000). Stage B moves only isolated fixture timer deadlines to a declared burst or spread beginning five seconds ahead, then lets real workers process. No frozen clock, SMTP or LLM requests. Completion polling interval is 1s; Go memory includes benchmark client+API+worker in one process. Two transient mock provider outcomes (429/500) are injected. Up to five serial authenticated UI reads/sec rotate across nine routes, including journey insights and drilldowns, throughout loaded phases; requests are not an open-loop saturation test. pg_stat_statements records top-level statement execution (including trigger cost); client network/round-trip time is not included. Timer lateness measures step completion after due_at, not claim time. EXPLAIN probes do not modify job state. Metrics/SQL timing and bounded queue sampling are enabled; no trace exporter is started. Optional pacing and provider delay are declared in the report. Successful-attempt latency excludes earlier 429 waits; logical latency includes them.
